integrity: The matrix-convergence claim is derived from exact secant, orthogonality, block-structure, and asymptotic identities in the cited construction. No numerical experiment is treated as proof, and literature-search failure is not treated as proof of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the explicit two-dimensional active-subspace counterexample of arXiv:2609.00596.
No quantitative rate is claimed for \(\|B_k-I_n\|_{\mathrm{op}}\).
No extension is claimed for inexact line search, limited-memory BFGS, or general quasi-Newton trajectories.
title: Exact Hessian recovery inside a Q-order-one BFGS trajectory
